_base: Make one 16:9 video using the attached image as the exact first frame (image-to-video, Veo 3.1 Lite, 1 output, 8 seconds). Lively cartoon animation of this exact picture from my own game: keep every character's design, colours and style exactly. {X} No new characters, no text, no speech or dialogue, no scene cut.
cut-open: The golden spoon gleams and sparkles, candle flames flicker, the kaiju pop up one by one from behind the plates with greedy eyes, licking their lips and nudging each other, the camera slowly pushes in toward the spoon. Playful orchestral heist music and cartoon sound effects.
cut-0: The crab kaiju snaps its claws angrily, stomps its little feet, then snips a carrot in half and huffs, gravy steam rising. Comedic cartoon music, snip-snip and stomp sound effects.
cut-1: The octopus juggles the cutlery faster and faster, the jelly blob wobbles and jiggles, a spoon bonks the blob on the head and it splats and reforms, both laugh. Bouncy comedic music, boing and clink sound effects.
cut-2: The fridge light flickers, the toast bat flaps its crusty wings and swoops, the marshmallow moth flutters out of the takeaway box scattering noodles, both strike a tough pose. Spooky-funny music, fridge hum and flapping sound effects.
cut-3: The conveyor belt rolls the crowned dragon smoothly into frame as it smirks and waves dismissively, the salmon bodyguard cracks its knuckles, soy sauce ripples. Cool swaggering mob-boss music with a Japanese twist.
cut-4: The elephant's bubblegum bubble grows huge and POPS, splattering pink gum over the chocolate golem who looks up from the cake covered in frosting and gum, confetti bursts. Party horn, pop and slapstick sound effects with silly party music.
cut-5: The pizza raptor spins its pizza cutter and lunges, the avocado kaiju dodges with a cheeky flip as the giant cleaver chops down between them with a THUNK, both freeze and stare at the cleaver. Dramatic samurai-standoff music with comedic timing.
cut-6: The muffin bear flips a pancake high in the air, flames flare up from the griddle, the pancake lands on the crab's head, the toast bat bangs the counter laughing. Sizzling, ding-ding order bell, fast diner jazz music.
cut-7: The giant crowned jelly blob wobbles menacingly and roars, frost spreads across the counter, ice cream scoops start melting and dripping, the moth peeks out and gulps. Ominous-but-silly boss music, wobble and freezing sound effects.
cut-8: The grape hound leaps and catches the paper plate in its mouth, grapes flying off its body, ants scatter, the avocado and salmon kaiju duck as it bounds over them. Cheerful whistling summer music, barks and boings.
cut-9: The dumpling kaiju slams the dough down, a big puff of flour explodes, the dough swells and rises enormously, the muffin bear and chocolate golem back away slowly. Thumping villain music with comedic squelch sound effects.
cut-10: The lazy Susan spins faster and faster with the happy rice-ball gorilla giggling in the middle, dishes whirl past, the sushi dragon and bubblegum elephant wobble and get dizzy, swirling stars over their heads. Merry-go-round music with whoosh sound effects.
cut-11: The crowned dumpling boss rises from the toast throne and points the golden spoon at the camera with a smug grin, toasters pop toast into the air behind him like fireworks, the pizza raptor cracks its knuckles. Epic final-boss orchestral music with toaster pops.
cut-end: Confetti rains down, the kaiju cheer and jump, the golden spoon sparkles, then the camera slowly pans up the enormous wobbling tower of dirty dishes which teeters... and one plate drops with a clang. Triumphant fanfare that ends on a comedic sad trombone.
